constraints: Same canonical bounded table as direct federation; an empty deny-all table must return valid metadata independently of successful peer or bundle verification.

alternatives: Python shared lexical/table predicates with native-backed SHA-256.

rationale: KEEP after eight current methods: deny-all, full peer validation, pin/domain/floors/interval and rejection parity with direct federation all pass. Removing the snapshot pin predicate causes an existing assertion failure.

The current API shares the same table grammar without requiring a bundle to authenticate. Alternatives do not eliminate canonical-byte or external-trust requirements. No material semantic or deployment gain from migration is established.
